attributes.context: Appears under the C. EQUIPMENT TRAINING section of an employee training article. The surrounding text references the 40-hour annual training maximum in B.3 and provides a dispute process under Section E that limits grievances to Step Two and excludes arbitration.

extraction_text: In the event that the University introduces new equipment at any medical center/campus which materially affects work performed by a SX unit employee subject to this Agreement, the University shall provide adequate training on new equipment and/or methods of practice. Such training shall not be deducted from the forty (40) hour annual maximum in provision B.3. above.
